title: Read-only pull-request workflow and governed write separation

phases.objective: Remove repository and issue mutation authority from pull-request validation workflows while preserving the existing read-only evidence checks.

e2e_journeys.actor: pull request author and repository lifecycle reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: E2E integrity, HTTP fanout report, or supervisor assurance pull-request workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Each pull-request workflow checks out and validates the exact candidate using read-only permissions and contains no repository, workflow-state, pull-request, or issue mutation path.
steps: Run E2E contract reference integrity without the former Work Map dispatch bridge.
Run HTTP Generic API fanout taxonomy reporting without apply, commit, or push.
Run supervisor readiness and behavioral dry-run without issue-write authority.
Verify the separated write workflows have no pull-request trigger.
assertions: E2E integrity has contents read permission only.
Fanout pull-request reporting has no contents write, apply mode, commit, or push.
Supervisor pull-request assurance has no issue-write permission or issue command.
No live apply, provider call, database action, deployment, credential read, or external runtime write is introduced.

phases.objective: Preserve the required write capabilities only through independently triggered governed workflows.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Explicit Work Map recovery, exact-head fanout apply, or scheduled supervisor alert workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The existing Work Map recovery bridge remains connected, fanout apply requires exact-head authorization, and supervisor issue reconciliation remains limited to schedule or manual dispatch.
steps: Bind the Work Map recovery contract to the existing independent recovery-dispatch workflow.
Require fanout apply target branch, expected head SHA, typed confirmation, and protected-branch rejection.
Run scheduled or manually dispatched supervisor assurance before issue reconciliation.
Keep all write workflows free of pull-request triggers.
assertions: Work Map content still has one sole remote writer.
Fanout apply verifies local and remote head identity before mutation and before push.
Fanout apply rejects main and Production and never force-pushes.
Supervisor alert lifecycle may write issues but cannot be triggered by a pull request.
No workflow is dispatched by this repository change.

phases.objective: Fail closed when pull-request write authority, stale branch identity, protected-branch mutation, force push, or mixed validation/mutation semantics reappear.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository lifecycle and E2E governance gates
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A candidate changing any governed workflow in this contract scope
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Regression and lifecycle gates reject mixed pull-request writes or unguarded apply semantics before merge.
steps: Validate pipeline connectivity against the independent Work Map recovery bridge.
Validate report/apply and assurance/alert workflow separation.
Run repository lifecycle evaluation against every changed workflow.
assertions: A pull-request workflow with any write permission is rejected.
A fanout apply path without expected-head verification or protected-branch rejection is rejected.
A separated write workflow with a pull-request trigger is rejected.
No secrets are included in evidence.

phases.objective: This repository workflow-governance prerequisite has no provider canary authority.
This repository workflow-governance prerequisite performs no Production action or deployment.
